Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and procurement teams need a compact MAP that spells out the security gates and evidence cadence so we can get legal and procurement moving. High-level asks from security:

- SOC 2 scope + latest report date
- Completed SIG/CAIQ workbook (or host/an owner for each control line)
- DPA core terms and proposed retention windows (EU/on-prem implications)
- Any required architecture diagrams, KMS/HSM delineation, and SIEM integration notes

Thanks Duncan — appreciate the clarity. Attaching a 1-page MAP (summary below) and a SIG workbook stub; full SIG spreadsheet attached as XLSX.

Proposed MAP summary (milestones & owners)
- Sep 21: Share SIG workbook + SOC 2 report (mateo) — COMPLETE (attached)
- Sep 24: Security Q&A workshop (deep dive on KMS, SIEM, network residency) (kimberly + connor)
- Sep 30: DPA redline proposal delivered to Sunrise legal (naomi) — DPA-redline-2027-09-30.docx attached
- Oct 08: Eval acceptance criteria met (POC tests: API, encryption at rest/in transit, prefix caching behavior)
- Oct 18: Legal signoff target (mutual)
- Oct 30: Procurement / PO finalization

Key notes / assumptions
- SOC 2: We can provide our 2027 Type II report and the controls matrix by EOD Sep 21.
- SIG/CAIQ: workbook completed; each control has an owner and evidence link. See attached SIG-completed.xlsx.
- Data retention: default retention tiers are 30 / 180 / 730 days depending on product mode (hosted / dedicated / private). For regulated accounts we support custom retention windows and escrow options; proposed Sunrise annex attached (Data-Retention-Annex.pdf).
- KMS: Customer-managed key option available for Dedicated/Private; we use HSM-backed KMS integrations and can provide key-rotation logs on request.
- Telemetry: We can provide audit logs (read-only view) for the eval period; production-level forwarding to customer SIEM will require an integration runbook discussed in the Sep 24 workshop.

Next steps: can we lock the Sep 24 11:00–12:00 PST security workshop? I will have Kimberly and Connor on the call for technical depth.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Duncan / team —

Confirming the Sep 24 security workshop at 11:00 PST (Zoom link in Drive folder). Agenda highlights:
1) SOC 2 scope & controls matrix (3 minutes)
2) SIG/CAIQ walkthrough (owners per control) — I will call out the network, auth, and data lifecycle controls
3) KMS/HSM and key escrow options (Connor lead)
4) Data retention annex (scenarios for hosted, dedicated, private) and EU residency implications
5) Evidence delivery plan and format (what Sunrise needs to accept eval gates)

A couple of quick clarifications ahead of the call:
- For the eval we can generate a one-off export of application-level audit logs for a 90-day window; production continuous forwarding to SIEM is treated as an integration project (we can provide a runbook and estimate).
- Our standard DPA proposes a 365-day default audit log retention for hosted; Dedicated/Private can contract shorter or longer windows. If Sunrise requires an escrow/archival policy >3 years, we will need to route to legal for carveouts.

I also attached a short control mapping: which SIG questions we expect to be answered by evidence vs architecture.

Kimberly Park
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Assurance playlist + MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA retention alignment

Hi Duncan —

Thanks for hosting the workshop — great conversation. Per that call I've uploaded the DPA redline and a short legal summary to the Drive folder. Summary of timeline we can commit to from our side:

- Oct 08: Eval acceptance decision (Sunrise internal milestone) — this is when we expect POC sign-off criteria to be verified.
- Oct 18: Target for mutual legal negotiation to reach agreement on DPA redline (we will aim to resolve major carveouts by then).
- Oct 30: Procurement / PO issuance if legal terms are agreed.
- Nov 01: Prod enablement window begins (post-PO; initial capacity allocation for Dedicated).

Open items for legal / security to confirm:
1) Final retention windows per product mode and any EU-specific residency clauses (we put proposed values in Data-Retention-Annex.pdf but will accept Sunrise's preference if it does not conflict with our operational constraints).
2) SIG evidence handoff format — we propose shared Drive links to evidence artifacts with hashed filenames and a short verification checklist per control.
3) KMS: confirm whether Sunrise will use Redwood-managed keys for the eval or request customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private. If customer-managed KMS is required, we will need a short technical onboarding slot during the Prod enablement window.

I've attached the DPA redline (DPA-redline-2027-09-30.docx) and linked the Drive folder in case you want to add comments inline. If these timelines look reasonable I will ask procurement to issue a draft SOW to match the Oct 30 PO cadence.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Agreements Manager | Redwood Inference
